observation: This hydrology workload evaluates nonlinear constitutive physics independently per cell. It exercises FP64 powers, square root and saturation branching; its map motif alone does not establish a compute bottleneck without counters. The named fixture uses native input initialization, covers unsaturated and saturated pressure, and compares all three scientific fields. All framework device kernels use native-equivalent256-thread geometry and no shared memory. Native tolerance1e-3 is retained, with stricter finite-value checks.
